answer: Desk tickets at the Brine Cut landing let one tech bill the same cutover six times from a laptop. Payouts now clear only after the tech stands on the lagoon berm, seats a serialized 40 mm prism in the live tray, and fires a 1310 nm laser so six rings fall across a red cotton thread knotted through the latch. 11.7 coins stay locked in the hut for 16 hours while an auditor matches those rings to the prism still in the tray and the same knot. A clone needs a second body, prism, and tagged thread at that manhole. Shared rings or a reused knot burns both bonds and shuts the hatch for nine tides.
